summary: Seal maker in Ravensteiner Holding (650 staff, EUR 151 M); we are 0.54 % of its turnover. Capacity tight: allocating volumes, cannot confirm our forecast, extra volume only against a binding 12-month commitment. Pricing committee above 2 %. Price of the 24 mm seal is 23 % over the should-cost of its plant. Arena P10: barely moves, final offer in round 2, trades price for 56-day lead time, 36 months and binding volume. Open moderate.
notes: Wants firm long-term commitments and longer lead time; fears unplanned volume. Group KAM: delivery and volume-record arguments 'do not change our calculation', but a should-cost citation is accepted. Refuses cost breakdowns. Contradiction: claims full capacity yet adds volume on 36 months. Rivals: sup:70440 on the 32 mm seal (1.9 % cheaper), sup:70430 qualified on the gasket.
fears: short lead times it cannot meet

playbook.expected_concession: Arena P10: first counter about 1.5 % below its open, final offer in round 2, 1.5-3 % total when we accept 56 days, 36 months and binding volume; keeping 42 days left its final offer 4-7 % higher.
